verdict.rationale: Brex's marketing touts 'AI-powered automation' for invoice entry, GL coding, and financial ops, but this is backend automation rather than a conversational assistant users delegate tasks to, and community evidence directly disputes Brex's AI capabilities—an early ChatGPT-based expense bot was criticized for factual errors, sloppy engineering, and being 'mostly a recruiting exercise,' and later commenters note Brex 'didn't successfully make the AI pivot' compared to competitors like Ramp.
